title: Bank Holidays August 2026: Plan Your Finances Around 14 Closure Days
description: Banks across India will observe up to 14 holidays in August 2026, as per the RBI calendar. These holidays include national, regional, and weekend closures, va.

faq.q: How do I find the official bank holiday list for my state?
faq.a: You can find the official bank holiday list by visiting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) website (rbi.org.in) and navigating to their holiday calendar section.

faq.q: Will online transactions like UPI or NEFT work on bank holidays?
faq.a: Yes, digital services like UPI and IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) work 24x7, even on bank holidays. NEFT (National Electronic Funds Transfer) transactions are also processed, though inter-bank settlements might be delayed until the next working day if the receiving bank is closed.

faq.q: Can I deposit cash or cheques at an ATM on a bank holiday?
faq.a: While most ATMs allow cash withdrawals on holidays, cash deposit functionality varies by ATM and bank. Cheque deposits can often be made at ATM drop boxes, but their processing and clearance will only begin on the next working day.

faq.q: What if my loan EMI due date falls on a bank holiday?
faq.a: If your EMI is set up for auto-debit, it typically gets processed on the next working day. However, it's prudent to ensure sufficient funds are in your account a day before the holiday to avoid any potential bounce charges.

faq.q: Are all bank holidays observed nationwide?
faq.a: No, bank holidays are categorised into national holidays (observed nationwide) and regional holidays (observed only in specific states or regions for local festivals). Standard weekend holidays (Sundays, second and fourth Saturdays) are nationwide.
